office_does: The prosecuting attorney prosecutes crimes in Franklin County and is the legal adviser to county officials and boards.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Prosecuting Attorney Shawn P. Sant (Prefers Republican Party), in office since 2011, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Franklin County Prosecuting Attorney since 2011, a former deputy prosecutor, police officer and Air Force veteran; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Prosecutor since 2011; earlier deputy prosecutor and police officer [S1]
Backs therapeutic courts alongside offender accountability [S1]
Says budget cuts and reduced staffing strain the office as cases rise [S1]
